name: whole-flow-with-harness-mounted
title: A user's whole flow, with the harness actually mounted
description: The previous round claimed a user's whole flow and measured a bare Pi session: the project was never bound, the run recorded executionMode standard, and its transcript contains no mention of a mode, an action policy or an effect refusal. This round establishes what has to be true for the harness to be present and then measures the flow with it present, on the same project and scenario, so the only variable is whether the harness is there.
